name: Country loaf
intro: A simple everyday loaf with a little whole wheat for flavour. This is the recipe I am learning on.

method.step: Feed the starter so it peaks in the morning.
Mix flour and 350 g of the water. Rest 45 minutes (autolyse).
Add levain, salt and the remaining 25 g water. Squeeze until combined.
Bulk ferment at about 24 °C. Four sets of stretch and folds in the first two hours.
Pre-shape, rest 20 minutes, then shape and place in a floured banneton.
Cold proof in the fridge for 12 to 16 hours.
Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at 250 °C: 20 minutes lid on, 20 to 25 minutes lid off at 230 °C.
